Name: Fs- Nitro Chiral Outfits for Stardew

Description:
I was very disappointed with the severe lack of anything BL in the Stardew modding community, so I decided to pull myself up by my bootstraps and add what I want myself!!

Included are all 5 MCs from each game, as well as:

-Keisuke
-Noiz
-Clear
-Rei
